Gets the payment method class, and it is MANDATORY on this payload for a reason: it is the only
cross-tenant-stable way to bucket revenue by method. string PublicPaymentModeReference.Name is renamable and
int PublicPaymentModeReference.Id is tenant-local, so a consumer totalling collections by payment method across
practices has nothing else to group on.

PublicPaymentModeReference.description:
The payment method a payment was taken by, inline on the payment payload.
    A DISTINCT type from PublicPaymentMode, which /v1/financials/payment-modes returns. That
record publishes six fields — it adds displayName, order and isDeleted, which are
about how the practice ARRANGES its list of modes, not about the payment. Reusing it here would put three
fields on every payment that say nothing about that payment, and would make the lookup's field set
un-evolvable: adding a field there would silently widen this payload.
    The three fields here are the three a consumer needs to attribute the payment: the id to join on, the
label to show, and the type to bucket by.

id.description: Gets the payment reason id. This is the value a payment's `paymentReasonId` refers to.

description.description:
Gets the description. This is the column's name and the field name on the wire — the inline
reference object on `/v1/financials/payments` already publishes it as `description`, and the two must
agree.

isUseInsurance.description: Gets a value indicating whether the reason is used for insurance.

isSystem.description:
Gets a value indicating whether this is one of the platform-seeded reasons rather than one the
practice created.

isActive.description:
Gets a value indicating whether the reason is active. Inactive reasons stay in this lookup: the table
has no audit columns, so there is no other way for a consumer to notice a practice turned one off.

isDeleted.description:
Gets a value indicating whether the reason has been removed by the practice. Deleted reasons stay in
this lookup because historical payments still reference them; a consumer that only wants the
currently selectable reasons filters on this field.

PublicPaymentReason.description:
A payment reason: the practice-configurable list a payment's `paymentReasonId` points at.
    Property order is the wire order, and it is the field set PLA-1064 published — nothing more. The stored
row also carries DesignationID; Designations is out of the public surface entirely per
PLA-1053, and the read path does not load it, so this record cannot grow that field by accident.

id.description:
Gets the payment reason id. Tenant-local, and resolves against `/v1/financials/payment-reasons` — which
returns removed and inactive reasons too, precisely so a historical payment's reason stays resolvable.

description.description:
Gets the reason's label. `PaymentReasons.Description NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL`, so `required`
    rather than nullable — the whole object is null when the payment has no reason, so there is no state in
    which this is present and empty.
    A PRACTICE-CONFIGURED LOOKUP LABEL, not operator free text about this payment. It comes from a row in
PaymentReasons that the practice created once and reuses; it is not typed per payment and it
carries no patient detail. That is why the payment surface audits its reads with
carriedFreeText: false where the invoice, estimate and credit-note surfaces cannot.

isSystem.description:
Gets a value indicating whether this is one of the platform-seeded reasons rather than one the practice
created. Published because it is the only way to tell a reason whose meaning is fixed platform-wide —
and therefore comparable across tenants — from one a single practice invented.

PublicPaymentReasonReference.description:
The reason a payment was recorded under, inline on the payment payload.
    A DISTINCT type from PublicPaymentReason, which /v1/financials/payment-reasons returns, on
the same reasoning as PublicPaymentModeReference: that record adds
isUseInsurance, isActive and isDeleted, which describe the practice's CONFIGURATION
of the reason list rather than this payment.

PublicPaymentStatus.description:
Payment state. Fully derived from the internal deleted and voided flags, which are not exposed, so it
needs no Unknown sentinel: every input maps to exactly one of these three.

PublicPaymentType.description:
Payment method class. The only cross-tenant-stable way to bucket revenue: a payment mode's name is
tenant-renamable and its id is tenant-local.

PublicProviderSelectionType.description: How a provider is attached to a line or item. Its own zero value is the sentinel.

PublicServiceType.description: Catalog service classification. Its own zero value is the sentinel.

value.description:
Gets the value, exactly as it appears in an entity payload and exactly as the `status` filter
accepts it: the contract enum's declared PascalCase name, e.g. `PartiallyPaid`. The host
registers `JsonStringEnumConverter` with no naming policy, so enum VALUES are not camelCased
even though property NAMES are.

PublicStatus.description:
One status value: the wire string an entity's `status` field carries and its `status` filter
    accepts.
    One type serves all seven status lookups (PLA-1071). There is nothing per-status to carry — no id, no
tenant-local label, no ordering key — so seven identical single-field records would only put seven
interchangeable types in every generated client.

line2.description: Second address line. Always `null` in v1: no source model carries it.

state.description: Full state name. `null` for offices, which do not resolve it.

country.description: Country name. `null` for offices, which do not resolve it.

PublicAddress.description: A postal address. All seven fields are always present; those a resource cannot source are null rather than omitted, so one renderer works everywhere.

id.description: Stable identifier. This is the value an appointment's `locationId` carries.

officeId.description: The parent office. `null` in four cases: the FK is unset; the office row does not exist; the office is soft-deleted; or the office is unstaffed and therefore absent from `GET /v1/practice/offices`. A non-null value is guaranteed to resolve against `GET /v1/practice/offices/{id}`.

type.description: Classification. Always present; inner fields may be `null`.

timeZone.description:
IANA time zone id, e.g. `America/New_York`. `null` when the stored value cannot be resolved —
never a Windows id, and never a guess. A `null` here means any accompanying instant was interpreted
as UTC.

PublicLocation.description: A physical location where the practice delivers care. Locations sit beneath offices.

PublicLocationType.description: A location's classification. `code` is an OPEN string, not a closed enum — new classifications arrive as data with no change to this API, so tolerate unrecognized codes.

id.description: Stable identifier, referenced by `PublicLocation.officeId`.

address.description: Postal address. `state`, `country` and `line2` are always null.

PublicOffice.description: An office: the grouping a practice's locations belong to. address.state, address.country and address.line2 are always null for offices, and offices carry no fax field.

PublicPracticeInfo.description: The practice's own profile. A singleton for the authenticated tenant — there is no id.

id.description: The legacy user id.

userName.description: The user name, or `null` if not set on the underlying record.

displayName.description:
The display name (`"{FirstName} {LastName}"`). A ragged string (extra whitespace) when one of the
name parts is missing — inherited from the underlying data, not corrected here.

firstName.description: The first name, or `null` if not set.

lastName.description: The last name, or `null` if not set.

email.description: The email address, or `null` if not set.

workPhone.description: The work phone number, or `null` if not set.

mobilePhone.description: The mobile phone number, or `null` if not set.

title.description: The title (e.g. "Dr.", "Mr.", "Ms."), or `null` if not set.

gender.description: The gender, a free-form string (no fixed vocabulary at the legacy DB level), or `null` if not set.

npi.description:
The National Provider Identifier, or `null` if not set. Public information (looked up via NPPES),
not PHI/PII — included, unlike the other bounded-context/sensitive fields this resource excludes.

userType.description: The user's legacy type. Never UserType.Patient or UserType.RefByPhysician — excluded upstream.

status.description: Always `true` in practice (inactive accounts are excluded upstream); kept for forward-compatibility.

usersDbId.description:
The linked `UsersDb.Users.Id` (the modern, global user record), or `null` if no such record
exists for this user yet — a `UsersDb.Users` row is created lazily on first login, so this is not
guaranteed to be present. Only the link itself is exposed; none of the bounded-context data that hangs
off it (permissions, security groups, licenses, custom settings) is part of this resource.

PublicUser.description:
The minimal public identity/profile projection of a user. Deliberately excludes SSN, date of birth,
permissions, security groups, custom settings, licenses, EHR-workflow flags, image URLs, role, and
speciality — this is the entire externally exposed field set. NPI is included (see string? PublicUser.Npi) —
unlike the other excluded fields, it is itself public information (looked up via NPPES), not PHI/PII.

Bearer.description: Bearer access token. Send it as the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.
